gap: Price details for rentals and membership not stated
blurb: Guests can rent modern, meticulously cleaned and serviced pontoon boats equipped with Bluetooth radios, removable tables, ample storage, and comfortable seating. The boats have large swim platforms, bimini tops, and life jackets for safety. The lake offers opportunities for cruising, swimming, fishing, and docking at waterfront restaurants and bars.
extraNote: Strongly encourage calling ahead to secure boat in July and August
